_README: ONE config file drives the whole tracker (scraper + dashboard). Personalized for a post-PhD chromatin biology / computational genomics job search in Denmark. All matching is case-insensitive substring on the JOB TITLE unless noted.

profile.title: Denmark Life Sciences / Computational Biology Job Tracker
profile.subtitle: Copenhagen · Greater Copenhagen · Denmark

keywords._comment: A job TITLE is kept if it contains any of these. Use full words; multi-word phrases match as substrings. Kept deliberately broad here because scoring (scoring_profile.json / triage_agent.py) does the fine-grained semantic filtering — this stage is a coarse net.
keywords._exclude_comment: Titles containing any of these are dropped outright before scoring even runs.

search_terms._comment: Queries sent to each board's search box. Broader than keywords.include on purpose.

_search_terms_note: ziprecruiter is left empty — JobSpy's ZipRecruiter adapter is US/Canada-only and will not return Danish results; the workflow can stay enabled harmlessly (it will just return nothing) or be disabled in Actions to save a CI run.

locations._comment: geoId left blank for all Danish entries — LinkedIn resolves location text directly. We'll capture numeric geoIds during live testing (Phase 3) if tighter filtering turns out to be needed. Indeed/Glassdoor/Google Jobs use JobSpy's location+country; 'Denmark' as country is used since JobSpy's Denmark coverage needs to be verified live.

linkedin.name: Copenhagen
linkedin.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark

location_filter._comment: Case-insensitive substrings matched against a job's location text. Used to post-filter boards without geo-scoping (curated direct-ATS sweep). Sweden included per user preference: only unusually attractive roles there should be prioritized — that judgment happens in scoring, not here.

google_jobs._comment: Leave empty to auto-build queries. Add SERPAPI_API_KEY or OXYLABS credentials as GitHub Actions secrets if the free JobSpy path gets blocked for Danish queries.

jobspy._comment: Only needed if JobSpy-backed boards get blocked from CI IPs for Danish searches — common failure mode worth watching for during Phase 3 testing.

hiring_cafe._comment: HiringCafe's public SEO route currently defaults to US results — Danish coverage from this source may be thin or nonexistent. Flagging for verification in Phase 3; not a blocker for the other sources.

employers._priority_comment: Companies worth a daily priority digest even on a quiet day. High-priority Danish pharma/biotech first, then consulting, then broader Danish biotech discovery targets to expand over time.
employers._exclude_comment: Not excluding pharma/biotech here since that IS the target domain, unlike the upstream example config.

priority_topics._comment: Roles touching these get a gold star + dashboard filter. Tuned to the candidate's PhD specialty for immediate visual triage.

role_categories._comment: Dashboard 'Role' filter buckets, applied top-to-bottom to each title.
terms: project manage|project coordin|program manage|program scien|technical project

notify._comment: Pushover retained as a secondary optional channel; the primary daily digest will be the new email module built in a later phase. min_fit intentionally high given the 'few excellent jobs, not many mediocre ones' priority.
